newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia Q2 GDP unrevised, earlier qtrs up.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia Q2 GDP unrevised, earlier qtrs up.

text.p: Australian June quarter GDP growth remained unrevised at 0.1 percent, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said on Wednesday.
However, March quarter growth was revised up to 2.1 percent from 2.0 percent and the December quarter to 0.8 percent from 0.4 percent.
Growth in the 1995 September quarter has been revised down.
Economists generally expected the September quarter growth rate to fall and the December to rise because of big revisions to inventories data, issued on Monday.

Original data showed that although the bureau left its June quarter GDP-Average growth rate unchanged, it now has a stronger view of its expenditure-based estimates (GDP-E) for that quarter, mostly because of stronger private consumption and dwelling investment.
But the GDP-I (income-based) estimate was revised down.
